_comment: SB campaign keyword → ASIN resolution rule.  Operator-editable.  Used by the SB ingestion (Layer 3) when a campaign name contains a keyword that doesn't match master's category values directly.

_help.brand: Restrict resolution to ASINs of this brand (required).  Match is case-insensitive against master.Brand.

Match modes (use any one).category_l1: Exact value or list of values from master.category_l1
Match modes (use any one).category_l2: Exact value or list of values from master.category_l2
Match modes (use any one).category_l1_contains: Substring(s) to match anywhere in master.category_l1.  Case-insensitive.
